title: DevGate core -> Fleet Manager: capacity request (contract v1)
description: The only document shape in which open-core code asks Fleet Manager for execution capacity (REPO-003). Producer: core. Consumer: Fleet Manager. Closed to unknown properties: a field nobody declared cannot cross this boundary.

contract_version.description: Major contract version. A consumer that does not implement this major refuses the document (repo-003-02); it never guesses.

request_id.description: Correlation id the core side chose. The decision echoes it, so a decision can be matched to its request without trusting ordering.

created_at.description: When core emitted the request (RFC 3339 with offset).

ref.description: Git ref the job will run at.

labels.description: Requested runner labels; a self-hosted match needs at least one.

trust_class.description: The isolation class the job must run under. Closed enum: a new class is a v2 document, not a free-text field.

ephemeral.description: Runner jobs run in destroyed environments. Pinned true in v1: a persistent-runner request is not expressible.
